notes.title: 2.0 Build Is now Live
notes.content:
This bumper 2.0 Updates include:


 New Funhouse Levels
 New Bonus Levels
 New Bonus Fruits to collect
 New Mini Map to find all the Bananas
 Improved Banana Layouts for all levels
 Stage End Transitions and Animations
 Animated Menus and Improved Transitions
 Improved controller support in menus
 Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Go Bananas Demo is available now!
notes.content:
Play the free demo of Go Bananas now!

Enjoy a taster of sweet banana collecting fun. This free demo includes 10 challenging levels to sink your teeth into, all from the final game. Don't miss you chance to try before you buy!
